title: Residential Electricity Supply Disputes: Tenure Courtesy
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Electricity Supply billing dispute, when the agreement's service start date is 12 or more whole months before the referral date the long dispute tenure courtesy of 2.00 USD is added to the disputed amount, when it is 6 to 11 whole months before the mid dispute tenure courtesy of 1.00 USD is added, and when it is fewer than 6 whole months before nothing is added.

| Whole months from service start date to referral date | Dispute tenure courtesy |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 2.00 USD |
| 6 to 11 | 1.00 USD |
| fewer than 6 | nothing |

**Counting.** The service start date is the switch meter read date recorded on the agreement. A month is whole once the same day of the month is reached.

**Boundaries (hypothetical service start 2025-02-20).** A referral on 2026-02-20 is 12 whole months and adds 2.00 USD; on 2026-02-19 it is 11 and adds 1.00 USD; on 2025-08-20 it is 6 and adds 1.00 USD; on 2025-08-19 it is 5 and adds nothing.
